title: Code and results for: Within-Recording Evaluation Inflates Personalised Wearable Detection of Workload and Stress
description: Analysis code, result tables and pre-written claims files for the manuscript 'Within-Recording Evaluation Inflates Personalised Wearable Detection of Workload and Stress: Block Identity, Drift and Simple Controls' (submitted to Sensors, MDPI). The study re-analyses seven public datasets (COG-BCI, UNIVERSE, MultiPhysio-HRC, WESAD, MAUS, ds007554, CogWear); the datasets themselves are not redistributed.
